Name: No Auto Forbid (Native)
Description: Stops Stardeus from auto-forbidding dropped weapons, stripped equipment, asteroid/meteor loot, derelict resources and (optionally) items you move yourself. No Harmony and no Rosetta required. Console: noforbid [dropped|stripped|spaceloot|derelict|moved] [on|off] - 'on' means the game forbids it.
